submissions_this_run.message: baseline10: YOLO11n COCO-init, 10ep, 640px, no label edits (inference conf 0.25)
tuned200: YOLO11n COCO-init 200ep cos-lr; conf=0.001 (val mirror mAP50 0.6641)

best_local_validation.val_protocol: organizer-revised val (733 imgs, 2725 boxes), COCO mAP@0.5 mirror (code/eval_coco.py)

key_findings: Confidence threshold was the dominant lever: val mirror mAP50 (maxDets=100) rises monotonically as conf drops 0.25->0.001 (0.5639->0.6641 baseline10); the model under-predicts vs the revised-labels ground truth. Public gap val->public was -0.075 in two independent submissions.
Epochs barely matter: 10ep baseline (0.6827 ultralytics val) ~= 200ep tuned200 (0.686): all 12 classes exist in COCO pretraining, so the ceiling is set by train label quality.

Train labels are under-annotated vs the rulebook (train 3.21 boxes/img vs revised val 3.72). Dual-model consensus (baseline10 x tuned200, both conf>=0.5, agree IoU>=0.3, both unmatched) yielded 125 boxes in 121 images; visual sample review (24/24 real objects) confirms quality.

A full 200-epoch retrain on the +125-box labels (v2full200) scored 0.6614 on the val mirror vs 0.6641 for the original-label model: net-neutral (Boat/People improved, Chair/Cup/Table/Dog regressed); not submitted. Fine-tuning a converged model costs ~0.014 mAP50 (A/B at lr0=0.002).
failures_and_reconciliations: 2026-10-21T17:57Z & 18:00Z: two skill-wrapper submission attempts failed at GCS upload (www.googleapis.com unreachable on this network); reconciled via account status (0 submissions registered, no slot consumed); fixed with code/submit_direct.py (host rewrite to storage.googleapis.com). Both runs' receipts and reconciliations are in .kaggle-skill/ledger.jsonl.
eval_coco.py bug: det boxes were passed as xyxy instead of COCO xywh (and empty per-class det lists crashed loadRes); fixed 2026-10-22T02:55+08:00 and validated against the 50-image subset.

kit_v2 data-layout bug: ultralytics derives label paths from real image paths, so symlinked images silently used the original labels; invalidated v2ft120 and the 'A/B' pair, fixed with real (copied) image dirs, re-ran as v2full200.
compliance_notes: Locked contract respected throughout: YOLOv11n only, official COCO-pretrained yolo11n.pt (sha256 0ebbc80d...44ee1) as init, imgsz 640, single model; no TTA, ensembling, pseudo-labeling, or external data/images.

Label editing: 125 train boxes added from predictions of two runs trained by this account under the locked contract (allowed source per rules); the rules prefer individually human-reviewed edits, but this run is unattended - the additions were agent-applied under a strict dual-model consensus filter (both models conf>=0.5, IoU>=0.3, both unmatched to GT) and visually spot-checked (24/24 real objects). Disclosed per AGENTS.md.
Test split: images used for inference only; no test labels obtained or used; no leaked-label attempts.
Training compute: local GPU pool (A100-80GB, host GPUs 2/3) via tools/local_training.py; no remote compute used.

runner_up_models: models/runs/v2full200/weights/best.pt (v2 labels, not better on val)

stopping_rationale: Public 0.59039 (rank 49/89) is the best of 3 evaluated artifacts (mirror 0.6641/0.6614/0.6642); the model is data-ceilinged (~0.69 ultralytics val regardless of epochs/labels-tried). Further gains require large-scale rulebook re-annotation of the 5910 train images (thousands of boxes), which is not achievable within this run's constraints. One quota slot left unused today by design; quota resets 2026-10-24.
